bu'i gling thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ston pa'o zhes pa'i don to/ /mthu ni 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan rnams su gdul bya thams cad la bden pa ①bstan pa'i ched du'o/ /ye shes kyi rjes su 'gro ba ni ②gcig mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pas chos la bdag ④med pa'i rnam pas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das par mos pa'i phyir ro/ /chos kyi dbyings ltar rgya che ba ni ngag gcig brjod pas gdul bya mos pa sna tshogs pa rnams kyi sems la cig car go bar byed pas so/ /smon lam 'di rnams sa ④gong ma rnams su rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /mos pas ⑤spyod pa'i sa la ni 'di lta 'di ltar gyur zhes mos pa rnams so①/ /de bzhin du sa 'di nas bzung ④nas byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims dang ting nge ⑤'dzin dang shes rab dang rnam par grol ba dang rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po rnams yongs su sbyong bar byed do/ /⑨'dir dang po gsum ni ⑫lhag pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i bslab pa gsum mo/ /⑫rnam par grol ba'i phung po ni mi slob pa'i lam mo //⑫rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po ni mi slob pa'i ⑫yang dag pa'i lta ba'o⑫ / /de bzhin du yang / 'di smon lam ⑫las dngos po thams cad la ltos ⑫pa med pas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la blo rgya che ba ⑫spro ba yang dag par skyes pa / ⑫mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa las rang gi don bzhin du gzhan gyi don rnams la 'jug bzhin pa ni stong pa 0chen po la rab tu 'jug ste/ 0gang 0gang gi 0don du gnyer ba ④de ④de la ster bar byed cing phyi rol ༅lam nang 0yang rung ba ༅gang yongs su mi gtong ba'i dngos po de med de/ de ltar 0'di'i gtong ba 0chen po 'byung ngo / /ji skad du 'phags pa sa bcu par gsungs pa/ sa 'di 63—1477

la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la sangs rgyas mang po rnams snang bar 'gyur te/ mthong ba rgya chen po nyid dang smon lam gyi stobs kyis nas/ ji srid sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag mang po rnams ①kyi bar dang ②de de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams mthong nas lhag pa'i bsam pa rgya chen po nyid kyis bkur ster ②byed/ bla mar byed/ ri mor byedaX/ ⑤mchod par byed do nas ji srid byang chub sems dpa'i ④bde bar sbyar ba rnam pa thams cad kyang nye bar sgrub pa ④dang / ⑤dge ba'i rtsa ba de rnams kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ⑨bar byed do/ /des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams la mchod pa las sems can yongs su smin par byed pa kun du skyes pa yin te bsdu ba'i dngos po rnams kyis sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed cing de las 'di'i ⑫sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa chos shin du lhag par 'gyur la/ pha rol tu phyin pa lhag ma ⑩rnams la ⑫yang dag par mi spyod pa yang ma yin no zhes so/ /yum chen mo dag tu yang ༅gsungs pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji srid du byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa rgya chen po dang / bdag nyid chen po'i bsam pa ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' /la pa/gang 'di khyarnams brgya byin nyid dang 'jig rten skyong ba nyid dang 'khor los sgyur ⑫ba nyid la sogs pa'i ⑩phun sum tshogs pa rnams don du mi gnyer la⑫/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu dge ba yongs su sngo bar byed do nas ji srid /nyadu 'di rnams ⑫chags pa med pa dang 0'dzin pa med pa nyid de/'di ni 0'di rnams kyi rgya che ba'i bsam pa nyid do/ /gang yang de'i chags pa med pa'i bde ba dang 'dzin pa med pa'i bde ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde 63—1478

ba ste bde ba de thams cad kyang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du 'dod cing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su sngo bar byed pa/ 'khor ba yongs su gtong ba nyid kyis te/ 'di ni ①'di rnams kyi bdag nyid che ba nyid kyi ②bsam pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos rnams te ②de rnams thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems babyed ④par bgyi'o zhes so/ /⑤de la mthong ba rgya che ba nyid ni gang du rjomathu'i khyad par gyis ⑦gzugs kyi sku mthong ba'o/ /smon lam gyi stobs kyis ni gang nang gi yang dag pa'i don lam las ⑧chos kyi sku mthong ba'o /⑨thabs mkhas pa nyid kyis mang po nyid dang rab tu gyur pa bstan pa'i don du grangs rnam pa mang po'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 0pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom ⑫pa ni bsam pa la brten pa yang ste de yang rnam pa drug ste/ mi ngoms pa chadang / rgya che ba dang / dga' ba dang / phan pa dang / gos pa med pa dang / dge ba'i bsam pa rnams kyis so/ /'dir byang chub sems dpa' sems can gcig la skad cig gcig la yang gang gā'i klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i ⑫'jig rten gyi khams rin po che ④thams cad kyis bkang pa rnams ⑫ster zhing / ⑫de dang mnyam pa'i lus rnams kyang ⑩de dang mnyam pa'i bskal par ⑫skad cig so so la sbyin par byed la/ ⑩sems can gcig la ji lta ba de bzhin du sems can gyi khams bla na med pa 0yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par bya ba ji snyed pa de la yang 0ngo / /gzhan yang ⑤/ lam sha'i 'bras mchog ldan pa'i longs spyod shing las ji lta bar/ /dogs pa dang 63—1479

bral lus can bsam pa rang bzhin gnas rnams kyis/ /①gang gi nor rdzas rgya che'ang blangs nas rang nyid longs spyod pa/ /gtong dga' longs spyod can de byang chub sems dpa' las gzhan min/ /zhes so/ /'di lta bus mi ngoms pa ⑤kho na ni sbyin pa'i bsam pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa brgyud pa de lta bu'i ②ngo bo skad cig tsam yang nyams par mi byed cing byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi bar du rgyun gcod par mi byed de/ 'di lta bu ni sbyin pa la rgya che ba'i ①bsam pa'o/ /sems can de rnams de ltar sbyin pas rjes su 'dzin pa po sdeches dga' bar 'gyur gyi/ ④sbyin pa des rjes su gzung bar bya bzhin pa'i sems can rnams ④ma yin no zhes pa 'di lta bu'i ngo bo ni spyin pa la dga' ba'i bsam pa'o / /gang sbyin pas phan btags pa'i sems can de rnams la byang chub sems dpa' bdag la ches phan 'dogs par blta'i②/ bdag nyid ni ⑨ma yin te/ ༅de rnams ⑪bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub nye bar ston pa rgyur byas nas bso/ /'di ni phan pa'i bsam pa'o sems can rnams la de ltar sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams rgya chen po mngon par 'dus byas nas kyang ④lan nam ⑫rnam par smin pa ⑫don du gnyer bar 'gyur ba ma yin te / 'di ni gos pa med pa'i bsam pa'o/ / gal te ⑫de ltar sbyin pa'i phung po rgya che ba rab tu sbyor ba'i rnam par smin pa ⑩sems can rnams kho na'i yin par mngon par dga' bar byed kyi/ bdag nyid la ma yin zhing / ⑫sems can thams cad dang thun mong du yang byas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ⑫bar byed de/ 'di ni dge ba'i bsam pa'o/ /gang byang chub sems dpa' lus gang gā'i klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pas/ che'i tshad 063—1480

de dang mnyam pa'i bskal par rgyun du yo byad ①thams cad kyis phongs bzhin du stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams mes ②yongs su gang bar spyod lam ②rnam pa bzhi byed cing / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i skad cig ma gcig nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa skad cig ma gcig gi bar du sgom par byed pas ④mi ngoms pa kho na ni ⑤de'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar sgom ④pa la ⑦bsam pa'o/ /sgom pa brgyud pa de yang byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi ⑧bar ༷du rgyun mi gcod pa ⑫de 'di ni rgya che ba'i bsam pa'o/ /sgom pa des ⑫ches dga' bar 'gyur gyi/ phan gdags par bya bzhin pa'i sems can rnams ni ⑫ma yin pa kho na'o zhes pa 'di ni dga' ba'i bsam pa'o/ /gang rnams la ⑫phan btags pa'i sems can de rnams la byang chub sems dpa' ⑩shin tu phan 'dogs pa por blta'i bdag nyid ⑫ni de rnams la ⑫ma yin te⑩/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub nye bar ston pa rgyur byas nas bso zhes pa 'di ni phan par byed pa'i bsam pa'o/ /de ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba'i bar gyi bsod nams rgya chen po mngon par 'dus byas nas kyang / lan nam rnam par smin pa don du gnyer bar 'gyur ba ma yin no zhes pa 'di ni gos pa med pa'i bsam pa'o/ /gang ⑫de lta bu'i bsod nams kyi phung po rnam par smin pa sems can rnams kho na'i yin par mngon par dga' bar byed kyi bdag nyid la ma yin zhing sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo 0bar yang byed do zhes pa 'di ni dge ba'i bsam pa'o/ /slar yang 0gsungs pa skad cig 63—1481

gcig gis ting nge 'dzin brgya so sor thob cing snyoms par 'jug go/ /sangs rgyas brgya mthong ngo / /①de rnams kyi byin gyi rlabs ⑤kyang shes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams brgya g.yo bar byed cing snang bar yang byed do/ /zhing brgyar 'gro ba dang ②sems can brgya yongs su smin par byed do/ /bskal pa brgyar gnas shing / sngon dang phyi ma'i mthar 'jug go/ /chos kyi sgo brgya rnam par 'byed do④/ /lus brgya ston par byed do/ /lus dang lus la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor brgya dang ldan par ston par byed do zhes so/ /'dir ting nge 'dzin gyi las ni sangs rgyas mthong ba la sogs pa'o/ /g.yo bar byed pa ni gdul bya rnams 'dul bar ④byed do/ /'gro ba dang snang bar byed pa dag gis ④song ste mthong nas ④yongs su smin par byed do/ /⑤'jug pa ni sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' las sems can rnams kyi sdig pa dang bral ba'i dbang du byas te las kyi ⑨'gro ba ston par byed do/ /rnam par 'byed de ⑩rang gi blo yongs su smin par bya ba'i don du/ chos kyi rnam grangs rnams kyi don sems so thams cad du brgya smos pa ni nges par 'byung ba nyid kyis so/ /thabs la mkhas pa nyid kyis ni grangs nges pa med pa las grangs nges pa ⑫yang ngo / /⑫de nyid kyi phyir 'dir mos pa ⑫spyod pa'i sa la yang ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa rnams ⑫thob pa dang / sangs rgyas la sogs pa rnams mthong ba la sogs pa yang ⑫gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas grangs med pa mthong ba ni tshogs kyi sar yang ste 'phags pa rtag par rab tu ngu ba bzhin no/ /de nyid kyi phyir ⑩rab tu dga' ba'i sa la yang ting nge 'dzin rnam grangs med pa nyid na yang rmi lam gyi gnas skabs bzhin dus de srid par snang ba'o zhes ⑩pa'i cha ni seng ge bzang po'i legs pa'i cha yin la gang yang ⑫63—1482

rtogs pa'i tshul gyis brtan par so sor snang ba nyid na de rnams kyis ①bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis thob par bya ba sangs rgyas nyid du de'i tshe kho nar ②'gyur ro zhes pa ②ni 'gal ba'i phyir bsam pa de ni legs pa ma yin no/ /gal te thabs la mkhas pas thams cad kyi tshe ①ting nge 'dzin rnams so sor snang bar 'gyur mod de lta na ⑤yang bsgom ④pa'i lam gyis spang bar bya ba'i dri ma rnams ④kyis na cher gsal ba med pa nyid kyi phyir dang / shin du ring bar khyab pa mchog tu gyur pa med pa nyid kyi phyir ⑧de'i tshe kho na sangs rgyas nyid du thal ba med do/ /de ltar dpag tu med pa'i yon tan gyi gter ④byang chub sems dpa' de ni phal cher 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbang phyug tu 'gyur zhing / ⑫dbang phyug chen po ⑫dbang rab tu thob la / 0chos rjes su bsrung zhing gtong ba chen po rtsom pa rnams kyis tshim pa med pa'o/ /las gang cung zad rtsom pa de sbyin pa'am snyan par smra ba'am/ don spyod pa'am don mthun pa nyid kyis ⑫te skye ba thams cad du'o/ /de la ⑫sbyin pa ni 0phyi dang nang gi zang zing sbyin pa ste/des gdul bya rnams chos sgrub par rung bar bskyed pa'i snod du 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa ni snyan par smra ba'o//don spyod pa ni chos ⑫la yang dag par 'god pa'o/ /don mthun pa ni gang spyol pha rol yang dag par bkod pa ⑫de la rang yang rjes su 'jug pa'o zhes pa bzhi sems can bsdu ba'i thabs rnams so/ /bsdu ba de yang mos 0pa spyod pa'i sar phal cher don med pa'o/ /sa bdun rnams la phal cher don yod pa'o/ /brgyad pa la sogs pa'i sa rnams la rnam pa thams cad du don yod pa ste sems can gyi don lhun gyis grub par gdon mi za bar phun sum tshogs pa'i 0phyir ro/ /63—1483

byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi skye ba ni rnam pa bzhi ste las kyi dbang gis ni mos pa spyod pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams kyi ste/ las kyi dbang gis ①mngon par 'dod pa'i gnas su skye ba'o/ /smon lam gyi dbang gis ni sa la bzhugs pa rnams ②sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i don du skye ba la dbang ba nyid kyis dud 'gro la sogs pa ②dman pa'i gnas su skye ba gang yin pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gis ni ④bsam gtan rnams ⑤bzlog nas 'dod pa'i khams su skye ba gang yin pa'o/ /dbang 'byor pa'i dbang gis ni sprul pa rnams kyis dga' ldan gyi gnas la sogs par skye ba kun du ston pa gang yin pa'o zhes pa'o/ /gzhan yang ④gsungs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje ni/ /srid par gnas pa'i rgyu yin te/ /de ni gnas pa byed kyang blo/ /zhen pa rjes su sems ma yin/ /zhes so/ /der 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid la chags pa med par spyod cing / 'dod pa ⑦la yongs su longs spyod pa rnam pa mang por ston par byed kyang ⑤de la chags pa med do/ /'jig rten pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i yo byad thams cad sogs par byed cing de la yang zhen pa med par 'gyur ro/ /④bdag dang bdag gi bar 'dzin pa sngon ma can nyid kyis na 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad ni rnam par smin pa ⑩sdug bsngal ⑪gyi rgyu kho nar 'gyur la chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar bsgom ⑩pas ni sems can gdul ba rgyur byas nas nyon mongs pa la dbang ba nyid thob pas 0bsam pa'i khyad par las sgyu ma'i skyes bu bzhin du ⑫'dod pa yongs su longs spyod pa/ rgyal ba'i sras po rnams la skyon byed pa ma yin pas so/ /de skad du yang / mdo sde rgyan la sogs pa rnams su gsungs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa rnams/ /63—1484

rtag tu 'khor los sgyur bar ni/ /'gyur zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /sems can don ni rab tu byed①/ /thabs chen ldan pa rnams la ni/ /nyon mongs ②byang chub yan lag 'gyur/ /'khor ba'ang zhi ba'i bdag nyid du'o/ /de phyir rgyal sras bsam mi khyab/ /ces so/ /yang na ②'di 'dod na khyim dang chung ma dang longs spyod thams cad dang / 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyang ④spangs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu 'byung ngo / /ji ltar yang ⑤'di 'di ④la 'di ltar rab tu 'byung ba de bzhin du sa gong ma rnams la yang ngo ⑦ /⑧byang chub sems dpa' rab tu 'byung ba yang thog ma kho nar/ ma dang pha dang bu dang chung ma la sogs pa yongs su 'dzin pa'i skyon de snyed pas ⑨yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro/ /yongs su gzung ba de'i don du zhing las dang nyo tshong dang rgyal po'i skyes bu byed pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pas sa ⑫yongs su dkrugs pa'i ⑪sdug bsngal las kyang ngo ⑫/ /mtha' gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa lu gu rgyud du spyod par nus so/ /⑩byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad la mngon par shes pa ⑫myur bar 'gyur te/ dge ba gang dang gang kho na rtsom pa de dang ⑫de mthar phyin pa kho nar 'gyur ⑩ra/ /brtul zhugs nges pa la gnas pa nyid kyi phyir thams cad du tshig ⑫gzung bar 'os par ⑫'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ⑫khyim pa ni ༅de lta ma yin no zhes pa de lta bu dang mthun pa'i chos rnams kyis khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba dag gi khyad par ro zhes byang chub sems dpa'i sar gsungs so/ /de lta bu ni 0sems bskyed pa ༅'di'i yon tan rnams so/ /sngar gyi sems bskyed pa'i 0yon tan can chadang mngon par shes pa ༅la sogs pa rnams ni 'di la 0cher 'bar ba dang ring du khyab pa'o/ /de'i gong ni 0sems 63—1485

bskyed pa'i yon tan rnams ni ①'tsham pa med pa rnams so/ /ji skad du/'phags pa sa bcu par ②gsungs pa/ de yan chad du byang chub sems dpa' smon lam gyi stobs can rnams smon lam khyad par can gyis rnam par 'phrul te/ gzhan yang ②lus ④sam 'od dam rdzu 'phrul lam spyan nam spyod yul lam dbyangs sam spyod pa'am ④bkod pa'am byin gyis brlabs pa'am ④mos pa'am mngon par 'du byed pa rnams kyang bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong ⑦rnams ji snyed pa de snyed du yang bgrang bar sla ba ma yin no zhes so/ /de bzhin du sa so so la chos kyi sprin gyi bar la gsungs so/ /⑧de la spyan ni rnam pa lnga'o/ /dbyangs ni sprul pa'i gsung ngo / /bkod pa ni sprul pa'o/ /byin gyis brlabs pa ༷ni gang gis pha rol byin gyis rlob ⑫pa'o/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo la brten nas mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du mthu'i ⑩bya ba'i don sgrub pa'o/ /shes rab kyi spyan gyis bsdus pa'i gzungs kyi sgo la brten nas chos ston pa mngon par 'du byed pa rnams so⑫/ /0de lta na yang ⑫de'i yon tan rnams bag tsam brjod par bya'o / /de la sems bskyed pa drug pa tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa ni ⑫ra ha na la sogs pa'i rin po che'i 'byung gnas lta bu ste/ yon tan rin po che thams cad ⑩de las 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /dri ma med pa'i sa yang ⑫ste/gang gi phyir 'di la tshul khrims 'chal pa'i dri ma dang bral ba ⑫de'i phyir ༅dri ma med pa'o/ /dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams kyang 'di'i lhag cing shin du dag par 'gyur te/ sems bskyed pa lnga pas rtsen 0pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 0de bzhin ma yin no/ /pha rol tu phyin pa bcu rnams las tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ches ༅shas che bar 'gyur ro/ /sa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems 63—1486

dpa' phal ches lagling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i rin po che sna bdun dang ldan pa stobs bcu ru ②'gyur ro/ /②sems can rnams kyi tshul khrims 'chal pa'i dri ma bzlog pa'i ched dang / dge ba la brten pa rnams dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams la dgod pa'i ched du'o/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po rnams kyang ④'di la snang bar 'gyur te/ rgya chen po mthong bas ⑤dang / smon lam gyi stobs kyis so/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i stobs kyis na so sor snang ba 'di yang nges pa med pa ste gnas skabs snga ma ④ rnams la bzhin no/ /nges pa las ni skad cig gcig gis ting nge 'dzin stong thob po/ /sangs rgyas stong mthong ngo / /⑦de rnams kyi byin rlabs kyang shes so//'jig rten gyi khams stong g.yo bar byed do/ /⑧snang bar ⑨byed do/ / zhing stong du yang byed do/ /⑫zhing stong du yang 'gro'o/ /sems can stong yongs su smin par byed do/ /bskal pa stong du gnas shing / sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mthar 'jug go/ /chos kyi sgo stong rnam par 'byed pa'o⑩/ /lus stong ston par byed do/ /lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor stong ston par byed do/ /snang ba la sogs pa rnams kyi grangs ma nges pa dang ⑫nges pa 'di dag kyang sems bskyed pa gong ma gong ma rnams la yang 0rig par bya'o/ /de bzhin du spyan dang mngon par shes pa la sogs pa sems bskyed pa snga ma'i yon tan rnams ⑫'di dang phyi mar yang thams cad du rjes su 'jug cing ⑫rab tu gyur pa shin du dang ches ⑫la sogs pa tha dad pa yang ngo / /sems bskyed pa bdun pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa ni rgya mtsho chen po lta bu ste/mi 'dod pa thog tu bab pa thams cad kyis mi 'khrugs ⑫pa'i phyir ro/ /⑫sa ⑫63—1487

'od byed pa yang ste ①gang gi phyir 'di la ting nge 'dzin ma nyams pa la brten pa ②chos kyi snang ba chen po byed pas so/ /'dir byang chub sems dpa' shin tu so sor rtogs pa'i shes pa can te phyir yang tshad med pa dam pa'i chos ②tshol ba la mngon par brtson par gnas shing / nyin dang mtshan du chos nyan pa don du gnyer ba ①dang / chos smra ba la dka' ba byed pa'i 'du shes su 'gyur ro/ /phyi'am nang gi dngos po gang ④de la mi sbyin pa de cung zad kyang med pa dang /bla ma la ④bsnyen bkur bya ba gang nyams su mi len pa de cung zad kyang med pa dang ④/ lus kyi gnod pa gang mi len pa de cung zad kyang med do/ /rtag par rab tu ⑧sbyor ba'i rgyu ni chos la gus pa mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /⑨de ni nor dang rgyal srid dang bde 'gror skye ba dang 'jig rten pa'i rnam par dag pa ⑩dang bdag nyid kyi lus pas kyang chos shin du gces par byed de/ ⑫de ni chos kyis shin du dga' bar 'gyur gyi/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa nyid ⑩ma yin la chos kyi tshig yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su sbyong ba gcig gi don du yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams mes skegang 8bar yang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar nas kyang bdag nyid 'dor bar spro na me'i 'obs tha mal par lta ci smos te 'on kyang bdag gis dmyal ba dang ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun du gnas pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su btsal bar bya na mi'i sdug bsngal la kun du gnas pas ⑫lta ci smos zhes ⑫brtson 'grus drag po rtsom pas ⑫ji skad thos pa'i chos rnams la ⑫tshul bzhin du so sor rtog pa'i rang bzhin can du 'gyur te chos de rnams thos na gcig tu 63—1488

dben par song bas 'di ltar dpyod de/ chos ①dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos ②bsgrubs pas sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di rnams khong du chud par bya'i/ ngag gi las yongs su dag pa 'ba' zhig gis ma yin no zhes 'phags pa sa bcu par gsungs so/ /②'dir chos ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rnam par grol ba'i chos so/ /de dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos ni rjes su mthun pa'i ④chos te/chos dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos sgrub ⑤pa'i stobs dag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams rig nas ④bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa dang tshad men ⑦pa dang mngon par shes pa rnams sbyor ba las thob kyi/ mngon par dga' ⑧ba la gnas pa ⑨nyid kyis ni ma yin te/ de kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /de la bsam gtan rnams la ni ⑩bde bar mngon par nga rgyal ba'i sems can rnams kyi dbang du byas ⑩pa'o/ /gzugs med pa rnams ni mthar par mngon par nga rgyal ba rnams kyi'o⑩/ /byams pa dang snying rje dag sdug bsngal can rnams kyi'o⑫/ /dga' ba dang btang snyoms dag grol ba rnams kyi'o⑫/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni skyabs ngan pa ⑫la zhugs pa rnams kyi dbang du byas nas te/ mthu khyad par can gyis ⑫gzhug pa'i don du'o/ /ma nyams pa'i bsam gtan la sogs pa ⑫thob pa'i phyir sa 'di ni ⑫de rnams kyis rab tu bye ba yin no/ /sa snga ma ༅dag na yang de rnams la snyoms par 'jug pa med pa ni ma yin no/ /'dir mngon par shes pa lnga rnams te/ de skad du yang 0mdor/ de rdzu 'phrul gyi bya ba rnam pa du ma so sor nyams su myong bar byed de sa yang g.yo bar byed do/ /rgyagacig tu gyur nas mang por 'gyur ro/ /mang por gyur ④nas gcig tu 0'gyur ro/ /snang bar 63—1489

gyur cing mi snang bar gyur te①/ ⑤rtsig pa la yang ②thad yi dang ra ba ④la yang thad sha dang / ri la yang thad gar mi thogs par 'gro'o/ /nam mkha' la yang ⑤'gro ba dang / sa la yang ⑥steng du 'byung ba dang byi'u zul byed do/ /chu la'ang ༅sa la bzhin du 'gro'o/ /du ba 'thul bar yang byed/ 'bar bar yang byed do/ /sprin chen po bzhin du lus las chu 'byin te/ chu gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi ⑤khams kun du 'bar ba yang zhi bar byed ༅pa'o/ /nyi ma dang zla ba dag kyang lag pas ⑫yongs su nyug ⑩par byed do//tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du ④yang lus kyis dbang bsgyur 0ro/ /so sor snang ba dang / bde ba yang ster ro/ /'od zer yang rab tu 'gyed do/ /de lha'i rna ba'i khams mi'i las 'das pas lha dang mi rnams kyi ⑫sgra rnams ⑫thos so/ /dmyal ba dang byol song dang yi dwags rnams kyi dang ⑫/ tha na sha sbrang dang sbrang bu mchu rings ⑩dang / srin bu dang bya dang bung ba rnams kyi yang sdug bsngal dang ldan pa rnams kyis ⑫nyen pa'i ༅sgra thos nas ④sdug bsngal de bsal ba'i ched du 'bad cing / khya 'di nyid du gnas nas zhing sna tshogs pa rnams na sangs rgyas rnams chos ston pa nyan no/ /des khyasems can ④pha rol dang gang zag pha rol rnams kyi sems kyang ༅sems kyis yang dag pa ༅ji lta bar rab tu shes te/'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems la 'dod chags dang bcas pa'o zhes pa dang /de bzhin du 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / zhe sdang dang bcas pa dang /zhe sdang dang bral ba dang / gti mug dang bcas pa dang / gti mug dang bral ba'i sems nas ji srid bla na med pa'i sems la bla na med pa'i sems so ༅zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /skye ba gcig kyang rjes su 63—1490

dran pa dang gnyis dang gsum nas ji srid skye ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya lastong gi bar yang rjes su dran no/ /nyi ma gcig dang gnyis dang gsum rnams nas ji srid du bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya ②stong gi bar rnams kyang rjes su dran no/ /②che ge mo zhig tu bdag ming 'di zhes bya bar 'gyur①/ rus ①'di lta bu/ ④rigs 'di lta bu/ kha gzas 'di lta bu/ yun 'di lta bur gnas/ /'a mtha' ni 'di lta bu thub/ bdag ⑧de nas shi 'phos nas che ge mo zhig tu skyes pa na ji srid de nas 1shi 'phos nas 'dir skyes so zhes pa nas/ ji srid yan lag ⑫dang bcas/ rnam pa ⑪dang bcas/ ched du bya ba ⑫dang bcas/ rgyu mtshan ④dang bcas pa'i sngon gyi gnas rnam pa du ma rjes su dran no/ /pha rol po rnams kyi yang sngon gyi srid pa khyade rnams kho nas dran du 'jug go/ /⑫des lha'i mig ⑩rnam par dag pa ⑫mi'i las 'das pas sems can rnams mthong ste/ 'chi bzhin pa dang skye bzhin pa dang / skyes ⑫pa rnams dang / kha dog bzang ba skyedang / kha dog ngan pa dang / dman pa dang ④/ gya nom pa rnams dang /bde 'gro dang / ngan 'gro las ji lta bar nye bar 'gro ba'i sems can rnams rab tu shes te/ sems can 'di rnams lus kyis 0legs par spyod pa phyedang /ngag gis 0legs par spyod pa ༅dang / yid kyis legs par spyod pa ༅dang ldan pa 'phags pa rnams la skur pa mi 'debs pa yang dag par lta ba can rnams te/legs par spyod pa'i rgyu des/ lus zhig nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du 0lha rnams su skye'o/ /sems can 'di rnams ni lus kyis nyes par spyad pa 0dang / ngag gis 6nyes par spyad pa dang / yid kyis ༅nyes par spyad pa dang ldan pa 'phags pa rnams la skur pa 'debs pa log par 0lta ba can rnams te/63—1491

log par lta ba yang dag par blangs pa'i rgyu las/ lus zhig nas shi ba'i 'og tu ①ngan ②song ②ngan ④'gro ⑧log par lhung ba dmyal ba rnams su skye'o zhes/ lha'i mig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du chos kyi dbyings kyis mas pa nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug par 'gro ba drug gi sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba ji lta ba bzhin rab tu shes so zhes so/ /'dir mngon par shes pa gcig rjogis sems can rnams nye bar gnon gno zhes pas khyab bdag nyid thob poX/ /gnyis kyis chos ston pa sgra dang don so so yang dag par rig pa las te/ sems shes nas skad gzhan rnams kyi ⑨don shes par byed pas so/ /⑫gnyis dag gis 'ong ba dang 'gro ba shes te/ sems can rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha'i yongs su smin pa shes so/ /rnam par dag pa ni gsal bar thos ⑫pa'i phyir ro/ /mi'i las 'das pa ni thag ring po ⑫thos pa ste/ mi'i sgra las shin tu 'das nas 'og tu ji srid mnar med pa'i bar gyi sgra thos par nus pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam pa ni 'di rnams thams cad tha dad pa'o/ /ched du bya ba ⑫ni ming ngo / /rgyu mtshan ni rigs la sogs pa rnams te/ gang gis skyes pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /⑫'di la sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po rnams snang bar 'gyur te/ mthong ba rgya chen po nyid dang smon lam gyi stobs kyis so/ /de yang phal cher sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i bdag po lha'i rgyal po'i ⑫dbang por ⑫'gyur la sems can gyi 'dod pa'i 'dod chags bzlog pa'i thabs yang dag par sgrub ⑫pa la mkhas pa ste/ sems can rnams 'dod pa'i 'dam las gdon pa'i don du'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa bcu rnams las spyobazod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu shas che bar 'gyur zhing bsdu ba'i 63—1492

dngos po rnams las don spyod pa'o/ /skad cig gcig gis ting nge ①'dzin brgya phrag stong ②thob pa dang / sangs rgyas 'bum mthong ba dang / de rnams kyi byin rlabs kyang shes ②so/ /'jig rten gyi khams stong phrag brgya g.yo zhing snang bar byed pa dang / zhing brgya phrag stong du 'gro ba dang / sems can 'bum yongs su smin par byed pa rjodang / bskal pa stong phrag brgyar gnas ⑤pa dang / ①sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' la ⑦'jug pa dang / chos kyi sgo 'bum rnam par 'byed pa ⑧dang / lus 'bum ston pa dang / lus so so la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor 'bum ston par byed do/ /de ltar thob pa'i yon tan ⑨'phel ba la spro ba dang ldan pa ni ⑫rtogs ⑩pa dang ⑫ma rtogs pa bya'aphel ba dang rtogs pa ⑫'byung ba'i phyir yon tan thams cad kyi rgyu brtson 'grus kho na'o zhes sems bskyed pa brgyad pa mngon par sgrub par byed do/ /⑫de yang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa rdo rje lta bu ste/ yid ches pa brtan ⑩pa nyid kyis na mi phyed pa'i phyir ro/ /sa ⑫'od 'phro ba yang ⑫ste gang gi phyir ⑫'dir byang chub kyi phyogs 0rnams kyis 0kun nas nyon mongs pa'i bud shing bsregs la/ de ༅las ye shes kyi me'i 'od 'byung ba'i phyir 'od 'phro ba'o //'dir yang byang chub sems dpa' la sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag mang po rnams snang bar 'gyur la skad cig gcig gis ting nge 'dzin bye ba brgya so sor 0thob pa dang / sangs rgyas bye ba brgya mthong ba dang / de rnams kyi byin gyi ⑫rlabs kyang shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya g.yo bar byed cing snang bar yang byed pa dang / zhing bye ba brgyar 'gro ba dang sems can bye ba brgya yongs su smin par byed pa dang / bskal pa bye ba brgyar gnas shing sngon gyi 63—1493

mtha' dang phyi ma'i mthar 'jug pa dang chos kyi sgo bye ba brgya rnam par 'byed pa dang / lus bye ba brgya ston pa dang / lus dang lus la yang byang chub sems dpa' bye ba brgya'i 'khor dang ldan par ston par byed do/ /phal cher lha'i dbang ①po rab 'thab bral du 'gyur la/ sems can rnams kyi 'jig tshogs la lta ba yang dag par 'joms pa la ②mkhas pa dang ②gtso bo ste/ sems can rnams ①yang dag pa'i lta ba la dgod pa'i ched du mkhas pa'o/ /⑤de'i bsdu ba'i dngos po rnams las don mthun pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa rnams las ①brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu shas che bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas sems bskyed pa dgu pa bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i ri bo lta bu ste/ dmigs pa'i rnam par g.yeng bas mi bskyod pa'i ⑦phyir ro/ /sa sbyang dka' ba yang ste/ ⑤gang gi phyir 'di la 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dag gi rigs ④pa dang bden pa shes pa dag phan tshun 'gal ba las yongs su sbyong ba bya ba dka' ba de'i phyir ⑫shin du sbyang dka' ba'o/ /'jig rten ⑪kyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i bdud rnams kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' ⑩'dir thub par ⑩mi nus so zhes pas shin tu rgyal bar dka' ba yang ngo //de ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa chen po ⑫mngon par sgrub pa'i sna tshogs pa'i thabs dang bya ba rab tu sbyor ba rnams kyis kyang sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed do/ /de khya de ltar sems can yongs su smin par bya ba la mngon par sbyor ⑫bas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi ⑫rjes su song ba'i sems kyi rgyun dang ldan zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba la sbyor ba la ⑫phyir mi ldog pa ste khyad par can gyi chos ⑫tshol ba la ༅mngon par brtson pas/ sems can la phan pa gang 'jig rten na rab 63—1494

tu spyod pa na①/ yi ge dang ②bstan bcos dang rgya dang ②grangs dang rtsis rjodang shod thabs la sogs pa ⑤dang / ④khams kyi rgyud ⑦dang gso ba'i rgyud dbul ba dang brjed byed dang 'byung po'i gdon ⑤sel ba rnams dang dgu ⑨dang ro longs kyi sbyor ba 'joms par byed pa rnams dang / snyan dngags ⑫dang gar thabs dang gtam rgyud ⑫dang / rol mo dang ⑫sngon byung bas rab tu dga' bar byed pa rnams dang / ⑫grong dang grong khyer dang skyed mos tshal dang 'bab chu dang ⑫mtsho dang mtshe'u spyodang rdzing bu dang me tog dang 'bras bu dang sman dang nags tshal mngon par sgrub pa rnams dang / ⑫gser dang dngul dang nor bu dang mu tig dang bai ḍūr+ya dang dung dang men ⑫shel dang byi ru dang rin po che'i 'byung khungs ⑫bstan pa rnams dang / ⑫zla ba dang nyi ma dang gza' dang rgyu skar dang 'od dang sa g.yo ba dang gcan gzan 0gyi lang 0nge dang rmi lam gyi ltas ston pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can gyi yan lag dang nying lag gi mtshan nyid spyod pa yidang rjes su spyod pa'i sbyor ba'i ltas rnams dang / sdom 0pa'i cho ga dang 0/bsam gtan dang / 0mngon par shes pa dang / 0tshad med pa dang /gzugs 0med pa'i gnas rnams dang / gzhan yang gang ④rnam par tho 'tshams ༅pa med pa dang / rnam par mi 'tshe ba dang ldan pa rnams dang / sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ba 0de rnams kyang snying rje dang ldan pas mthar gyis sangs rgyas kyi chos la 'god pa'i ched du mngon par sgrub po zhes 'phags pa sa bcu par gsungs so0/ /'di la yang sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po rnams snang bar 'gyur ro/ /skad cig gcig 6gis ting nge 'dzin bye ba stong thob po/ /sangs rgyas bye ba stong mthong ngo / /1de rnams kyi 63/de1495

byin rlabs kyang shes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams bye ba stong g.yo bar byed snang bar yang ①byed do/ /zhing bye ba stong du yang 'gro'o/ /sems can bye ba stong yongs su smin par byed do/ /bskal pa bye ba stong du gnas shing / sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mthar ②'jug go/ /chos kyi sgo bye ba stong rnam par 'byed do//lus bye ba stong ston par byed do/ /lus dang lus la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor bye ba stong ston par byed do/ /phal cher lha'i rgyal po yongs su dga' ldan du 'gyur te/ sems can thams cad mu stegs pa'i gnas thams cad las rnam par bzlog pa la byang ba ②dang gtso bo yin zhing sems can rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po 0rnams kyis bden pa ⑤la 'god pa la mkhas pa yin no/ /④bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la shin tu shas che bar 'gyur ro⑦/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa thob pa de las ⑧'di'i sems bskyed pa bcu pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa sman chen po lta bu ste/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i phyir ro//sa mngon du gyur pa yang ste gang gi phyir 'di la rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ⑨rnam par 'byed pa las chags pa med pa'i sgo zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gnas pa mngon du 'gyur te de'i phyir mngon du gyur pa'o⑩/ /'di la yang byang chub sems dpa' la sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong mang po rnams snang bar 'gyur ro/ /skad cig gcig gis ting nge 'dzin bye ba 'bum so sor thob po/ /sangs rgyas bye ba 'bum mthong ngo / /de rnams kyi byin rlabs kyang shes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya phrag stong g.yo bar byed snang bar yang byed do/ /zhing bye ba stong phrag brgyar 'gro'o/ /sems can bye ba 'bum 63—1496

yongs su man par byed do/ /bskal pa bye ba 'bum du gnas shing sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mthar yang 'jug go/ /chos kyi sgo bye ba 'bum rnam par 'byed par byed do/ /lus bye ba 'bum ston par byed do/ /lus dang lus la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor bye ba ①'bum ston par byed do/ /phal cher lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul dgar 'gyur te/ sems can rnams kyi mngon pa'i nga rgyal rgyun gcod pa la bya ②ba dang gtso bo yin zhing sems can rnams rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la 'dzud mkhas pa yin no②/ /'di'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ches shas che bar yang 'gyur ro/ /④de ltar/ blo ⑤yi ①'od zer gsal por snang ba can/ /rang gi lag mthil son pa'i skyu ru ra ⑦ji bzhin⑧/ /srid gsum ma lus ⑨'di ni gdod nas ma skyes par/ /rtogs te tha snyad ⑫bden pa'i stobs las ⑫'gog pa rtogs/ /⑫'gog pa thob pas 'gro ba yongs su skyob pa'i bsam pa yongs su gtong ba yang ma yin te⑩/ 'khor bar son pa'i ⑫sbyor ba ⑫dang mya ngan las 'das par son pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa ⑫ni⑫/ 'di'i 'gro ba mgon ⑫med pa la snying rje shin du ches 'phel bar byed pas so/ /de nas sems bskyed pa bcu gcig pa thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa bshes gnyen ⑪lta bu ste/ byams pa ༅dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms 0kyi mtshan nyid can mi zad pa'i tshad med pa ④dang ldan pa nyid kyis gnas skabs thams cad du sems can gyi don yongs su mi gtong ba'i phyir ro/ /ji skad ④du/bcom ldan 'das ma bar mar gsungs pa/ dge ba'i sems bskyed pa gcig kyang 0rnam pa thams cad mdon pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pas 0mi zad par byed 'dod pa dang sems can thams cad kyi don gyi ched du dmyal ba dang byol 63—1497

song gi skye gnas dang ①gshin rje'i ⑤'jig rten gyi ②sdug bsngal rnams la ⑤spro bar 'dod pa dang / bskal pa stong phrag brgyar bsags pa'i tshul khrims kyang sems can la ltos nas ⑤gtong bar 'dod pa ④dang / sangs rgyas kyi rigs ⑦su skye bar 'dod pa dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis rdzogs par byed 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o zhes sog/ /'dir sangs rgyas kyi rigs su skye ba ni khyad par du 'phags shing lhun gyis grub pa mtshan ma med par gnas pa'i las mi g.yo ba thob pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa 'di yang sa ring du song ba ⑫ste/ gang gi phyir 'dir byang chub kyi phyogs dang bden pa dang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la dmigs pa mtshan ma med pa'i gnas pa 'bad pas 'jug pa ste/ de'i phyir ⑪ring du song ba'o/ /'dir yang byang chub sems dpa' sems can la phan pa'i don du bsam gtan dang rnam par thar pa dang ting nge 'dzin gyi snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la snyoms par 'jug ste/ mngon par shes pa drug rnams la yang ngo / /de la rdzu 'phrul gyi bya ba shes pa rnam pa gnyis te/ 7yongs su bsgyur ba pa dang / sprul pa pa'o/ /dang po ni g.yo bar byed pa la sogs pa sngar ⑫ji skad bshad pa'o/ /sprul pa pa ⑫ni rnam pa gsum ste/ sku dang gsung dang yul gyi ⑫sprul pa las so/ /de ltar ni phyogs bcur grangs med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su grangs ⑫med pa'i sems can gyi don du skad cig gcig la yang 'gro ba drug gi sems can gyi gzugs kha dog sna tshogs pa ⑫sprul pa rnams kyis phun sum tshogs par byed doX/ /lha la sogs pa dang nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang ji srid phyogs 63—1498

bcu rnams su grangs med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams dbyangs kyis sprul pa go bar byed do/ /dbyangs de las kyang rnam pa du mar chos ston par byed do/ /yang na gzhan sprul pa rnams kyis ①byed du 'jug go/ /②nam mkha' la ②yang chos ston pa'i sgra 'byung bar byed do/ /yul ④rnams te/ bza' ba dang /btung ba dang / bzhon ⑤pa dang / gos dang ④/ rin po che la sogs pa sna tshogs pa rnams kyang sems can rnams kyi don du ⑩sprul par byed do/ /zag pa zad pa shes pas ⑧bdag ⑨gam pha rol po rnams kyi nyon mongs pa zad pa ji ltar gyur pa bzhin shes ⑫so/ /bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo dag tu yang gsungs pa/de 'di ltar rtogs par bya ste/ gang phyogs bcu gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams de rnams dang gang yang de rnams na de bzhin gshegs pa ⑩de rnams thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa ⑫ming 'ba' zhig pa sngar brtags ⑫pa'o nas chos thams cad chos thams cad kyis stong ngo zhes pa'i bar du ste/ de de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas nas ⑫mngon par shes pa drug rnams mngon par sgrub po/ /spyogang rnams la gnas ⑫nas phyogs bcu rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi drung du ⑫'gro zhing bsnyen bkur byed de⑫/de rnams las ⑫chos kyang nyan to/ /de rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams skrun par byed cing mngon par zhen pa med de/ stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen pa med pas so/ /de lha'i mig gis phyogs cu'i 0'jig rten gyi khams rnams su sems can rnams mthong nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon par shes pas ༅der song ste 0de rnams la chos ston par byed do/ /lha'i rna ba'i khams kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las ⑫chos mnyan te bzung ④nas ༅de rnams 63/de1499

la ston to/ /sems kyi rnam grangs shes pas sems can rnams kyi sems rnams rig ①nas bsam pa ji lta bar de rnams la chos ston to②/ /des bdag dang gzhan gyi sngon gyi gnas rnam pa du ma rjes su dran zhing / sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos rjes su dran nas chos ①des 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /de zag pa zad pa shes pas sems can rnams ④dang rjes su mthun ⑤par chos ston to/ /de mngon par shes pa de rnams kyis sems can rnams ni don gyi ched du lus gang dang gang 'dzin par 'dod pa ①de dang de kho na so sor 'dzin gyi ⑦de la bde ba dang sdug bsngal ⑧dang rjes su chags pa dang khong khro ba rnams kyis ⑨gos pa med do zhes so/ /⑩de nyid kyi phyir rtsod pa 'di 'jug pa ma yin te/ ⑩sems dang po bskyed pa kho nas byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur te/ nges pa yang ci ltar ngan 'gro rnams su skye ba yin zhes pa'o/ /gang gi phyir chagang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang tshad med pa bzhi la spyod cing mi dge ba'i chos bcu spangs nas gnas pa de'i mi khom pa brgyad rnams mi srid na 0ngan 'gror skye ba lta ci smos/ 'o na byol song gi ⑩skye gnas kyi skyes rabs rnams ci ltar yin zhe na/ ⑫de rnams ni zag pa dang bcas pa dang zag pa med pa'i dge ba'i chos thams cad dang ldan pa'i ⑫sems can gyi don gyi ched du ⑫dbang thob pa nyid kyis bsam pa ⑫bzhin du skye ba rnams te/ byol song gi sdug bsngal rnams myong ba yang ma yin no/ / 'di lta ste⑫ / de bzhin gshegs pa dbang 0gi mchog thob pa la/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du cig car mtha' yas pa'i sku 0gzhan gyi don gyi ched du sprul 63—1500

pa bzhin no/ /mngon par shes pa drug po 'di rnams byang chub sems dpa' la skye ba nas skye bar 'byung ste/ byol song gi skye gnas la sogs par ①yang ②mi nyams so/ /de ltar mngon par shes pa rnams kyis rjes su gzung ②ba'i sems can rnams kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i byams pas ①de'i gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa la khro bar mi byed do/ /gdug pa can dang nga rgyal can dang mu stegs ⑤gang ④de'i tshig la gnas par mi 'dod pa de rnams ⑤mgo dgas pa la sogs pas bskul zhing ⑤gsal bar byas nas bsdigs pas bdag nyid kyi tshig 'dzin du 'jug ste/ gang byang chub sems dpa' mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i tshig pa khro ba'i sems can de ni 'ga' zhig kyang yod pa ma yin no/ /gzhan du byang chub sems dpa' kho nas ⑨dus dang dus ma yin pa gzigs pa'i phyir ro/ /zang zing med pa'i sems kyis 'di chos ston par byed de/ snying rjes ⑫yang dag par bskul ba shes rab kyis sbyangs pa'i yid can rnams sems can rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched kho nar chos ston par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /⑫sa gong ma gsol ba ⑫rnams ma gtogs par stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su slob dpon du 'os par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa sa bcu par gsungs pa'i rim pas sa sbyong bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'bum phrag bcu rnams la snyoms par 'jug ste de thabs dang shes rab kyis yongs su sbyongs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams so sor thob pa las dang / snying rje chen po'i stobs kyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'da' bar 'gyur ba dang shes rab kyi 0ye shes kyis rnam par dpyad pas sa brgyad pa la mngon du phyogs par yang 'gyur ba dang / ⑫'di'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las mtshan ma dang bral ba tshad med par ⑫yang 'jug go/ /63—1501

la'o na sa dang po kho nar nyan thos la sogs pa'i spyod pa las 'das pa ma yin nam/slar yang 'dir ci zhe na/ ②der ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la lhag par dmigs pa'i bdag nyid che ba nyid kyis te/ rang gi blo'i rnam par dpyad pas ni ②ma yin no/ /ji skad du/ 'phags pa sa bcu par gsungs pa/ ④kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste/ dper na rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pa'i rgyal po'i bu rgyal po'i mtshan ma ⑤dang ldan pa ni rgyal po'i ④byin gyis blon po'i tshogs zil gyis gnon gyi/rang gi blo'i stobs kyis rnam par dpyod pas ni ma yin no/ /④de nar son pa na rang gi blo'i stobs bskyed pas kyang ngo / /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ⑤sems bskyed ma thag tu lhag pa'i bsam pa'i ⑨bdag nyid che ba nyid kyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis gnon gyi/ rang gi blo'i ⑫rnam par dpyod pas ⑫ma yin no/ /sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa ni rang gi yul ⑩shes pa'i ⑫khyad par gyi bdag nyid chen po la ⑫gnas pa nyid las nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bya ba las shin tu 'das pa yin no/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las zab cing dben la rgyu ba med pa thob pa yin te ⑫gong du khyad par 'tshol ⑫ba'i brtson pa yang mi gtong ngo zhes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i las ni khyad par du 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin la brten pa nyid kyis na ⑫mtshan ma dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi las ni mtshan ma dang bral bar 'jug kyang tshad med pa ma yin te/④sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba'i ⑫dbang du bya ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /0'di'i las ni sbyor ba'i spyod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir legs par sbyangs pa dang / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa snang ba rtogs pa'o/ /ring du 0song ba nyid 63—1502

kyi phyir zab pa'o/ /①de'i mi mthun phyogs kyi sgrib pa spangs pa'i phyir dben pa'o / /de las gzhan pa'i ②'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i sa la mi rgyu ba nyid kyi phyir rgyu ba med pa'o/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi las de ni mtshan ma dang bral ba yin yang ①'di 'dra ba ma yin la/ ④de tsam la gnas pa ste/ gong ma yongs su mi tshol ⑤ba'i phyir ro/ /gnas pa khyad par can yang ste 'di yang dag pa'i mtha'i ④gnas pas gnas pa'i phyir dang /'gog pa mngon du mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du 'phags pa sa bcu par gsungs pa/ bye rgyal ba'i sras sa drug pa nas bzung ④nas byang chub sems dpa' ⑧la snyoms par 'jug go/ /sa bdun pa la ni sems kyi skad cig nas sems kyi skad cig ⑨la 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang ste/ 'gog pa mngon du byas par brjod par bya ba yang ma yin no/ /⑫des na 'di bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las dang ldan pa zhes brjod ⑫nas ji srid du ⑫rtag par rgyun du dbe+en pa'i sems 'thob pa yang yin/ sems can yongs su smin pa'i don du smon lam gyi dbang gis ⑫khams gsum par skye ba yang mngon par sgrub pa ⑫la 'jig rten gyi nyes pa rnams kyis kyang mi gos so zhes pa'i bar du'o / /'dir yang dag pa'i mtha' ⑫la snyoms par 'jug pa ni ⑫'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug pa ste/ de bzhin nyid la 'gog pa zhes brjod pa las te/⑫'dir spros pa thams cad 'gog go zhes byas nas so/ /'di la sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po rnams kyang snang bar 'gyur la skad cig gcig ⑫gis kyang ting nge 'dzin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum so sor 'thob pa dang / sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum mthong ba dang / ⑫de rnams kyi byin rlabs kyang shes 63—1503

pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig 'bum g.yo zhing snang bar yang byed pa dang / zhing bye ba khrag khrig 'bum du 'gro ba dang / sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'bum yongs su smin par byed pa dang / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du gnas shing sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mthar rab tu 'jug pa dang /chos kyi sgo bye ba khrag khrig 'bum rnam par 'byed par byed pa dang / lus bye ba khrag khrig 'bum ston par byed pa dang ①/ lus dang lus la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor bye ba khrag khrig 'bum ston par byed do/ /phal cher ni lha'i bdag po gzhan 'phrul dbang byed du 'gyur te/ sems can rnams kyi ②mngon par rtogs pa'i ye shes sgrub pa la byang ba dang gtso bo yin zhing / sems can rnams skyon med pa la 'dzud mkhas pa'o/ /②'di'i thabs la mkhas pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu shas che bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yongs su sbyong ba'i sa bdun rnams dang 'bad pa dang bcas pas mtshan ma med par spyod pa'i ①yon tan rnams rtogs ⑤pa las sems bskyed pa bcu gnyis pa smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra ba ste/ ④smon lam ⑦ji lta bar 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'i ⑧phyir ro/ /⑨mngon par shes pa mi zad par yang ⑫ste/ mngon par shes pa rnams 0lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa'i phyir ro //sa mi g.yo ba yang ⑫ste gang gi phyir byang chub kyi phyogs dang ⑫bden pa dang ⑫rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ⑩la dmigs pa'i mtshan ma med par gnas pa ⑫rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba nyid kyi phyir g.yo ba med de de'i phyir mi g.yo ba'o/ /④phyir mi ldog pa'i sa zhes brjod de⑩/ ye shes mi ldog pa'i phyir ro/ /0'gro ba thams cad kyis shes par dka' ba nyid kyi phyir sgrub 0par 0dka' ba'i sa'o/ /163—1504

kha na ma tho ba med pa'i phyir gzhon nu'i sa'o/ /bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin dbang bsgyur ba'i phyir skye ba'i sa'o①/ /yang ⑤bya ba med pa'i phyir yongs su rdzogs pa'i ②sa'o/ /ye shes kyi rnam par dbye ba shin tu byas pa nyid kyi phyir yongs su mthar thug pa'i sa④'o/ /sngon gyi mtha' rnams su smon lam mngon par sgrub pa nyid kyi phyir sprul pa'i sa'o⑤/ /gzhan gyis mi 'khrugs pa'i phyir byin rlabs kyi sa'o / /sngon gyi mtha' rnams su mngon par sgrub pa nyid kyi phyir lhun gyis grub pa'i sa'o/ /dge ba'i chos rnams ④lhun gyis grub pa kho nas rnam par smin pa'i bdag nyid du 'byung ba'i phyir rnam par smin pa'o⑦/ /sangs rgyas rnams las sangs rgyas nyid ⑧du lung bstan pa thob pa'i phyir lung bstan pa'i sa'o/ /④lung bstan pa yang gang zag gi bye brag gis rigs la gnas pa sems bskyed pa mngon sum ⑩dang mngon sum ma yin par gnas pa'i gang zag lung ston pa las so⑪/ /lung bstan pa chen po ni sa brgyad pa la ste mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i phyir ro/ /sa ⑫'dir yang byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad kyi yang dag pa ji lta ba la 'jug cing / sems spyodang yid dang ⑫rnam par shes pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i ⑫'du shes thams cad dang bral zhing ⑫mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa zhes brjod par bya'o/ /⑫de thob pa las ⑫'di'i gang bde 'gro dang ngan 'gror rnam par smin par bya ba'i las kyi sgrib pa de rnams yang dag par 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan du ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ma 'ongs pa'i skye bo la rjes su brtse ⑫bas ston pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gnas pa zab mo shes par dka' ba 0dbyer med par 0mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba rjes su thob pa nas/ 0rnam par smin pa'i chos nyid la gnas pa yang ngo 063—1505

de la rnam pa thams cad du chaganyis la kun du spyod pa'am mtshan ma la kun du spyod pa ⑤snang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de ②'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug ④pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kho nas 'gog pa de las slong bar mdzad de/⑤ ji skad du 'phags pa sa bcu par gsungs pa/ de sngon gyi smon lam rjogyi stobs bskyed pa dang chos kyi sgo'i rgyun ⑦de la gnas pa/ de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes nye bar sgrub pa mdzad ④de/ ⑨de la 'di skad ces kyang bka' /de to/ /rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos sgogyerjes su rtogs par bya ba la 'di ni don dam pa'i bzod pa ste⑫/'on kyang rigs kyi bu gang nged rnams kyi stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa dang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa phun sum tshogs pa de /da la med kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos phun sum tshogs pa de yongs su tshol ⑫ba la mngon par sbyor bar 0gyis shig /༅brtson 'grus rtsoms shigaspyo /bzod pa'i ⑫go ⑫'di nyid kyang ma 'dor cig /gzhan yang /da kyis de ltar zhi ba'i rnam par thar pas gnas pa 8thob kyang byis pa so so'i skye bo ma zhi ba 'di rnams la soms shig /yang rigs kyi bu sngon gyi smon lam dang sems can gyi don thob par bya ba dang ye shes kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa ༅rjes su dran par gyis shig ste gang 'di chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang chos thams cad dmigs su med pa'o ༅nas/ ji srid du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' de la de ltar thams cad ma/de pa'i ye shes mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo rnams su gzhug pa mdzad pa ma yin te ⑫de kho nar ④'di'i yongs su mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur te/ 0sems can thams cad kyi bya ba rgyun 'chad pa'o zhes so/ /༅'di yang ༅gang yud tsam 63—1506

cig ①gis lhun gyis grub pa'i ④ye shes nyid kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnon pa de ni sngar gyi ④rtsol ba dang bcas pa'i las can gyis bskal pa 'bum gyis kyang de snyed du dpag tu med pa rjes su thob par mi nus so/ /༷'jig rten gyi khams rnams dang sems can rnams kyi so sor rab tu dbye ba rdul phra rab kyi rdul ji snyed pa de snyed rnams yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rab tu shes so/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig las kyang mi g.yo la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod ⑤du med pa rnams su dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams na yang ④so sor snang bar 'gyur ba yin no④/ /sems can rnams kyi ⑧lus rnam par dbye ba 1kha dog dang rtags dang ⑫dbyibs dang chu zheng rnams dang / mos pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa ci 'dra bar sangs rgyas kyi zhing de rnams su dang /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su yang de dang ⑪de lta de ltar rang gi lus kun du ston te/ dge ༷sbyong dang bram ze dang rgyal rigs dang spyokhyim bdag dang rgyal chen bzhi'i ris dang sum cu rtsa gsum dang 'thab bral dang dga' ldan dang 'phrul dga' dang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang tshangs pa rnams kyi gzugs rang rang gi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su ston pa nas ji srid du 'og min gyi spyo'akhor kyi dkyil 'khor rnams su 'og min gyi gzugs ston pa'i bar dang / nyan thos ⑫dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ⑫gzugs su ston te de dang de'i gzugs kyis gdul ba ⑫rnams kyi don gyi ched du'o/ /de ltar gdul bya'i lus dang sems dang skal ba mthun par bdag nyid kyi lus dang sems dag ston te⑫/ 'di ⑪yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ji skad du 'phags pa sa bcu par gsungs pa④/ de sems can rnams kyi sems 63—1507

dang bsam pa mngon par sgrub pa kun du shes nas ji ltar gdul bya yongs su man pa'i sems ①mi 'da' bar ②'dod na sems can gyi lus rang gi lus su byin gyis rlob pa'o/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi lus dang / las kyi rnam par smin pa'i lus dang / nyan thos kyi lus dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lus dang byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang / ②shes pa'i lus dang chos kyi lus dang nam mkha'i lus byin ④gyis rlob bo/ /rang gi lus sems can gyi lus su byin gyis rlob bo/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi lus la sogs pa nam mkha'i lus kyi bar du rang gi lus byin gyis rlob bo zhes so / /④'dir don dam pa dang kun rdzob kyi ye shes ngag gis ye shes ④rdzogs par byang chub pa la dbang ⑦ba'i sbyor bar rig par bya ste de la don dam pa'i ye shes ni lus su rnam par rtog pa thams cad ⑤bral ba nyid kyis dang / lus mnyam pa nyid ⑨thob pas bstan 0to/ /rang dang gzhan gyi rgyud ⑫yongs su mi gcod pas so/ /⑫'dis ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas 8thun mong ma yin pa'i don dam pa'i ye shes yongs su gsal bar byas par 'gyur ro/ /kun rdzob kyi ye shes ni sems can gyi lus la sogs pa rab tu shes pa ste/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba dang / gnyis ga ma yin pa'i phyogs rab tu shes pa'i phyir ro/ /de la sems can ⑫dang snod kyi 'jig rten ⑫dag dang de'i skye ba'i rgyu las kyis ⑫kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs rig par bya'o/ /theg pa gsum gyis rnam par byang ba'i phyogs te de yang ⑩le shes gang gis dang chos gang gis rab tu phye ba'o/ /nam mkha'i lus kyis spyoganyis pa ⑫ma yin pa'i phyogs so/ / ༅rang gi lus su byin gyis rlob pas ni dbang de dang de la bya ba mtshungs pa'i sgrub 63—1508

par byed pa'i sbyor ba nyid yongs su gsal bar byed do/ /dbang bcu rnams kyang sa 'di ①la so sor thob ②ste/ ②gang rnams thob pa las 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa la ni gnas pa nyid kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ①ye shes kyi bdag nyid chen po ⑤dang ldan pa yin zhing rjo/ ⑦rtag par rgyun du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ ⑤brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong ba ⑨la sogs pa rnams kyis bsu ba yin/ ⑩lag na rdo rje rnams rtag par phyir 'brang ba yin/ ⑩ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis ma btang ba yin/ lus rnam par phye ba tshad med pa mngon par sgrub ⑩pa yin/ ④lus kyi spyod pa'i stobs thams cad dang ldan pa yin/ mngon par shes pa chen po'i rnam par smin pa yongs su grub pa ⑫yin/ ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas pa la dbang byed pa yin/ lung bstan pa tshad med pa yang dag par tshol ba yin/ 'gro ba ji ltar smin pa ltar ⑫mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ston pa ⑫yin/ theg pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa yin/ bskal pa re re dang 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams ⑫re rer sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma rnams la bste stang byed btsun par byed do/ /chos ⑩kyi snang ba nye bar sgrub pa yang tshol lo/ /'di ⑫dge ba'i rtsa ba de rnams kyang rgya chen por 'gyur/ 0tshim par byed yongs su dag par 'gyur/ 'od gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa yang rnam pa dgu ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi don ni mi phyed pa'i don to/ /'di lta ste/ ye shes mi phyed pa dang / bshad pa 0mi phyed pa dang / rnam par grol ba mi phyed pa dang / zhing yongs su dag pa dbyer med pa dang / theg pa chen po la 'jug pa chadabyer med pa dang /63—1509

mngon par shes pa mi phyed pa dang / dris pa lung ston par nus pa dbyer med pa dang / byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug pa mi phyed ①pa dang / mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub pa dbyer med pa'o/ /'dis ②dang po ②sems bskyed par gyur pas kyang smon lam chen po bcu la sogs pa gang smon lam grangs med pa brgya mngon par bsgrubs ①pas de rnams ⑤'di'i yongs su dag par ④'gyur bas na smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i shin tu shas che bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar 'di sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams byams pa chen po'i snang ba spros nas sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i yongs su gdung ba rim gyis zhi bar byed cing rten ⑦rnams kyang tshim par byed cing rten rnams kyang rten par ⑧byed do/ /sa ⑨'di la yang nyon mongs pa kun du spyod pa ⑩shin tu phra ba yang med do zhes pas 'dod pa lnga la 0yongs su longs spyod pa mi srid pa kho na ste/ de lta na yang sems can yongs su smin pa'i rgyur byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan ༅lnga ⑫rnams nye bar len ༅te/ de ltar ni bsdu ba'i dngos po la mkhas pa bdag cag gi byang chub sems dpa' ⑫don mthun pa nyid kyis bsdu ba'i don du grags 'dzin ma dang sa skyong ma la sogs pa bud med stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams la so sor sku mngon par sprul nas de rnams thams cad dang rol 0to/ /gal te 'dod pa la spyad pa bden pa ma yin snyen de'i tshe sgra gcan 'dzin sras yin pa yang bden pa ma yin par 'gyur ro zhe na/ mi bden pa ma yin te/ sras rnams ni 'dod pa yongs su longs spyod 3pa'i rgyu las mngal du gnas shing skye ba kho na ma yin gyi/rdzus te skyes pa ༅rnams kyang 'byung ngo / /sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po yang byang 63—1510

chub sems dpa' chen po ste/ ①dgos pa'i dbang kho nar mngal du gnas pa'i rnam par ②bstan pa'o/ /②'phags pa chos 'phags sa bcu'i dbang phyug bud med stong phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad dang lhan cig 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis rtsen ④pa yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sbyor ba ni bla na med pa'i yul can gyi dga' ba la dbang ⑤ba'i rten ④nyid kyis na 'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin pa'i don du sems can ⑦mnyam pa nyid kyis rgyas par byed pa las te/ bud med kyi dngos po dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams kyis kyang rang dang gzhan gyi don rnam par dag pa'i ched du ⑤de'i 'khor gyi dngos po don du gnyer bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs par yang gsungs pa/ 'od srungs 'di lta ste/ sngags dang sman gyis yongs su gzung ba'i dug gis ⑨lhung bar byed mi nus so/ /'od srungs de bzhin du shes rab dang thabs la mkhas pa'i sman gyis yongs su zin pa'i ⑩nyon mongs pa'i ⑪dug gis lhung bar byed mi nus so zhes dang / 'od srungs 'di lta ste/ grong khyer chen po'i ljan ljin ⑫gang de⑫/ bu ram shing gi zhing rnams dang rgun 'brum gyi zhing rnams la nye bar mkho bar gyur par ⑫'gyur ro/ /'od srungs de bzhin du gang byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs pa'i ljan lngin ⑫de thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la nye bar mkho bar khyagyur par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /sa 'di la byang chub sems dpa' phal cher stong gi bdag po tshangs pa chen por 'gyur te/ zil gyis gnon pa⑫zil gyis mi gnon pa dang / dbang nyid thob pa gtso bo ste/ sems can rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nye bar sgrub ⑫pa'i ched du las thams cad kyang ⑩bsdu ba'i dngos po ༅rnams kyis rtsom mo/ /skad cig gcig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 63—1511

'jig rten gyi khams 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul ji snyed pa de snyed kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams so sor thob po/ /de snyed kyi sangs rgyas mthong ngo / /de ①rnams kyi byin gyi ⑤rlabs kyang shes so/ /de snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams g.yo bar byed snang bar yang byed do/ /de snyed kyi zhing rnams su yang 'gro'o/ /de snyed kyi sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed do/ /de snyed kyi bskal par gnas shing sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mthar 'jug go/ /de snyed kyi chos kyi sgo rnam par 'byed do/ /de snyed kyi lus ston to②/ /lus so so la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de snyed do/ /de ltar ༷sa brgyad pa la ye shes kyi las mngon par sgrub pa rnams kyis zhing yongs su dag pa rdzogs par byas nas ⑤dgu pa la sems can yongs su smin pa rdzogs par byed dorjo/ /de yang ⑦'di'i sems bskyed pa bcu gsum pa stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa nyi ma lta bu ste/ ⑧mi zad pa'i bsdu ⑨ba'i dngos po rnams kyis gdul bya'i sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /sa legs pa'i blo gros kyang ste/ gang gi phyir ⑫'dir byang chub sems dpa' so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ⑫kyis chos 'chad pa po nyid kyi phyir legs pa ste/ de'i phyir legs pa'i blo gros so⑫/ /de ni rteso so yang dag par rig pa bzhi rnams kyis chos smra ba po chen po'o/ /de ltar spobs pa mi chod pa can de'i sngon bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par smin pa'i bdag nyid yongs su rnam par smin pa khya'akhor ba ji srid par lhun gyis grub par sems can gyi don dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rdzogs par ⑫byed do/ /de nyid kyi phyir sa dgu pa'i spyod pa 'di nges pa'i spyod pa zhes brjod de/ smon lam kyi stobs kyis mngon par grub pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /spyod pa 'dis kyang yongs su 63—1512

smin pa'i sems can rnams theg pa gsum la nges par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par smin pa'i bdag nyid kyi phyir don yod pa'i spyod pa 'jug go/ /de nyid kyi phyir nges pa'i spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i nyi ma gcig la sems can gyi don gyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs par byas pa la snga ma'i spyod pa can ①rnams kyis bye ba stong phrag brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /②'di yang ②gzungs kyi sgo tshad med pa grangs med pa 'bum thob pa rnams kyis phyogs bcu rnams su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshad med pa grangs med pa rnams kyi mdun du chos nyan cing thos nas kyang mi brjed do/ /༷ji skad du thos pa yang ⑤grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu dang ldan pa'i dbyangs kyi yan lag la mkhas pas ④de snyed du tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i spobs pa rnam par phye ba'i sgos ④stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams thams cad du rgyas par bkang nas bsam pa dang mos pa ji lta ba bzhin sems can rnams la chos ston te/ ga'akhor mtha' yas pa zil gyis gnon pa'i mi 'jigs pa dang ldan zhing chos kyi stan la 'dug pas/ 'dod na sgra skad ⑨brjod pas 'khor thams cad la 0sgra skad sna tshogs pa tshad med pas chos kyi sgo rnams ⑫go bar byed do/ /sgra sna tshogs dang dbyangs kyi yan lag tha dad pa rnam par phye ba rnams kyis ⑩yang na'o/ /'dod na yi ge chagacig gi sgra la chos thams cad rab tu phye ba'i sgra 'byung bar byed do/ /ba spu'i khung bu ⑫las dang / 'od zer rnams las dang / nam mkha' las dang / 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med par ⑫son pa'i gzugs la sogs pa'i snang ba rnams ⑩las kyang ste/ ⑫'di ni mdor bsdus pa las 'di'i 8ston pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de yang rnam ⑫pa gsum du yongs su rtogs par bya ste/ ye shes phun sum tshogs 63—1513

pa dang / gsung phun sum tshogs pa dang / smra ba po phun sum tshogs pas so/ /de la ye shes phun sum tshogs pa ni gang theg pa gsum gyi dbye bas ①rnam par grol ba'i snod nyid la sogs pa ②ston pa'o/ /gang yang ②rigs dang dbang po'i ④rab tu dbye ba la sogs pa'i dbang du bya ba ni ⑤de'i yul lo/ /gsung phun sum tshogs pa ni so so ④yang dag par rig pas mngon par bsgrubs pa'i chos ston pa'o/ /de yang rnam ④pa bzhi ste/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis ston pa dang / de'i bshad pa ston pa dang / ⑧gang gi bsam pa ji lta ba ⑨de'i rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir rjes su 'jug pa ston pa dang / gang rnam grangs ji snyed pa rnams kyis rtogs par bya ba ⑩de ston pa'i phyir rjes su mthun pa ston pa'o/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis rnams ni mdo dang / dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / de lta bu byung ba dang /skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang /gtan la phab pa ⑫rnams so/ /de la mdo sde ni gang rkyang pa rnams ⑩kyis don gsal bar byed pa'o⑩/ /dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa ni gang mdo kho na dbus dang mtha' mar tshigs su bcad pas dbyangs su bsnyad pa'o/ /gang drang ba'i don gyi mdo de yang dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa ste༅/ rtogs par bya ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /lung bstan pa ni gang du nyan thos 'das te dus ⑫byas pa dang ⑫'byung ba lung ston pa'o⑫/ /gang nges pa'i don gyi mdor yang ⑫ste/ des ⑫rnam par phye nas dgongs pa 'chad pa'i phyir ro/ /tshigs su bcad pa ni gang tshigs bcad du gsungs pa ⑦ste/ de ni rkang pa gnyis pa dang / rkang pa gsum pa dang /63—1514

rkang pa bzhi pa dang / rkang pa lnga pa dang / rkang pa drug pa'o/ /ched du brjod pa ni ①gang yid rangs pas ②brjod pa'o/ /gleng gzhi ni ②gang ched du byas nas gsungs pa'am ④byung ba dang ldan pa'i bslab pa bcas pa gsungs pa'o//rtogs pa brjod pa ni dpe ⑤dang bcas par gsungs pa'o/ /de lta bu byung ba ni gang sngon gyi ④sbyor ba dang ldan pa'o/ /skyes pa'i rabs ni gang ④byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang ldan pa'o/ /shin tu rgyas pa ni gang byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang ldan pa ste/ sems can thams cad la phan ④pa dang bde ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rmad du byung ba'i chos ni ⑨gang du nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa' dang sangs rgyas rnams kyi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos ston pa'o/ /gtan la phab pa ni gang du chos kyi mtshan nyid phyin ci ma log ⑩par ⑫ston pa'o/ /smra ba po phun sum tshogs pa ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ gzungs phun sum tshogs pa dang / rab tu gsal bar byed pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / dris pa lung ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ⑫dang / 'dzin pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de la gzungs phun sum tshogs pa ni gzungs rnam ⑫pa bcu ste/ don gyi gzungs dang / ⑫gzhung gi gzungs dang / mngon par shes pa'i ⑫gzungs dang /'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa'i ⑫gzungs dang / phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcad ⑩pa'i ⑫gzungs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa dang sems can bkren pa rjes su 'dzin pa nye bar sgrub pa'i ⑫gzungs dang / theg pa chen po la zhugs ④pa'i sems can yang dag par gzengs bstod 0pa'i gzungs dang / chags pa 0med pa'i smon lam gyi yigazungs dang / spobs 0pa mi zad pa'i ༅gzungs dang /don sna tshogs la spobs pa'i ༅gzungs so/ /0'di ni ༅bskal pa bye ba mtha' 63—1515

yas pa las nges par 'byung ba la mkhas pa yang ste/ de ltar ni byang chub sems dpa' rnam par smin pa'i ①brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thob pa las bya dka' ba thams cad la bya dka' ba'i 'du shes mi skye'o/ /②de'i brtson 'grus shin tu chen po rtsom pas sgrub pa'i bskal pa mang po rnams bsnyil bar 'gyur te/dper na bdag cag ②bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa byang chub sems dpar gyur pa'i / sangs rgyas nyer ༷rgyal ⑤mnyes par byas pas bskal pa dgu bsnyil ba ①lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du shin tu ④che ba'i brtson 'grus kyis sgrub bzhin pa'i bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag mang po rnams kyang bsnyil bar 'gyur ro/ /gang yang de ltar thams cad khas blangs nas su zhig gi yang ⑧bskal pa grangs med pa bsnyil bar mi 'gyur ba kho na'o ⑨zhes pa'i 'dod pa de 'phags pas ⑫khyad du bsad pa ni/ 'bras bu gnyis pa la zhugs pa mthong bas thob pa'i dbang du byas nas/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams yod do nas ji srid du bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o zhes pa'i bshad pas/ gang gi phyir 'bras bu gnyis pa la zhugs pa ni sa drug pa la gnas pa ste ⑫sngar brjod pa'i rim pas ⑫bskal pa grangs med pa gnyis pa dang 'brel pa'i bskal pa bzang po rtenyid la gnas pa/ ༅de ⑫la yang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba ni / ci ltar bskal pa grangs med pa gsum pa bsnyil ba ma yin/ ci ste bskal pa bzang po la 'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa sa bcu gsol ⑫ba bskal pa grangs med pa gsum pa la gnas pa rnams kyang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'o zhe na ⑩'di las ⑫ci ste/ gang gi phyir mthong bas thos pas 63—1516

drug pa gsol ①ba rnams bskal pa bzang po la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pas na bskal pa grangs med pa bsnyil ba ⑤kho na'o zhes gnas so/ /de nyid kyi phyir phul du dbyung du med pa'i shin tu che ba'i brtson 'grus dang thabs kyi khyad par gyis sgrub bzhin pa rnams kyis ②bskal pa grangs med pa gnyis kyang bsnyil bar 'gyur ba nas ji srid bskal pa gcig la dang / skye ba nyung ngu'i ④sa dang /ji srid du skye ba 'di kho na la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'o zhes sngags kyi tshul las ⑤gsungs soX/ /④shas cher ye shes kyi snang ba 'di lta bu 'dzin par rtsom ⑧ste/ de gal te skra'i rtse mo'i go re re la 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med lapa'i rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams de snyed kyi 'khor gyi dkyil ⑩'khor rnams la chos ston zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa re res kyang de snyed kyi sems can rnams la don tha dad pa can gyi chos ston te/ sems can so so la'ang de snyed kyi chos rnams dang / skra'i rtse mo gcig la ji lta ba de ltar chos kyi dbyings thams cad na ste/ der bdag gis ji ltar skad ⑫cig gcig gis de bzhin gshegs pa bde rnams kyi chos kyi snang ba ⑫so sor nod ⑫pa de lta bu'i dran pa rgya chen po mngon par bsgrub par bya zhing ⑫/ shes rab kyi snang ba rnam par nges pa'i spobs pa yongs su sbyangs nas skad cig gcig gis 'jig rten gyi khams de snyed rnams su sems can thams cad tshim par bya'o zhes pa'o/ /bskal pa gcig la yang sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma rnams mthong ngo / /bsnyen bkur byed do/ /bla mar byed do/ /phal cher stong gnyis kyi bdag po tshangs pa chen por 'gyur te/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad ston pa la ⑫gtso bo yin zhing / 'dod na tshul de lta bu'i brtson 'grus rtsom ste/ gang skad 63—1517

cig gcig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab ji snyed pa'i grangs de snyed kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams so sor thob ①po/ /de snyed kyi sangs rgyas rnams mthong ngo / /②de rnams kyi byin gyi rlabs ⑤kyang shes so/ /de snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams g.yo zhing snang bar yang 'gyur ro④/ /de snyed kyi zhing rnams su 'gro'o/ /de snyed kyi sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed do/ /de snyed kyi bskal par gnas shing sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mthar ⑤yang 'jug go/ /de snyed kyi chos kyi ④sgo rnams rnam par 'byed do/ /de snyed kyi lus rnams ston te/ lus so so la yang de snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor lo ⑦'di'i stobs kyis pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu shas che bar 'gyur ⑤ro/ /de la ⑨bsam pa'i stobs ni nyon mongs pa kun du spyod pa ⑫med pa'i phyir ro/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa'i stobs ni sa'i ye shes yongs su sbyangs pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /gzungs kyi stobs ni chos mi brjed pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni rtag tu rnam par g.yeng ba med pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /yang dag pa'i 'byor ba'i stobs ni mtha' yas shing mur thug pa med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams ⑪kyi spyod pa rnam par dbye ba la mkhas pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /dbang gi stobs ni yid la re ba ⑫thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa 'thob pa'i phyir ro/ /spobs pa'i stobs ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rnam par ⑫dbye ba la mkhas pa ⑫nyid kyi phyir ro/ /don lam gyi stobs ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod pa la sbyor ba mi gtong ba'i ⑫phyir ro/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs ni bdag nyid kyis chasangs rgyas kyi ⑫chos yongs su smin par byed pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa dang / sems can 63—1518

thams cad la phan pa'i spyod pa mi gtong ba'i phyir ro/ /byams pa chen po'i stobs ni sems can thams cad bskyab pa la mchog tu sbyor ba ①mi gtong ba'i phyir ro/ /snying rje chen po'i stobs ni sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /chos nyid kyi stobs ni sgyu ma lta bu la sogs pa'i chos nyid mngon du byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ⑤byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs ni rnam pa ①thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la mngon du phyogs par gyur pa nyid kyi phyir ro zhes pa mdo sder ④bstan pa ni ④stobs rnams so/ /de ltar sa ④dgu pa la zhing yongs su dag pa dang sems can yongs su smin pa dag byas nas/ sa bcu pa la shes bya mngon par rdzogs par ④byang chub pa sgom pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do ⑧zhes pas sems bskyed pa bcu bzhi pa ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa ni dri za'i glu snyan pa 0lta bu ste⑩/mi zad pa'i so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ⑫rnams kyis ⑫gdul bya 'dun 0par byed pa'i chos bstan pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /sa chos kyi sprin yang ste/ gang gi phyir sa 'dir byang chub sems dpa' chos la rgyal tshab nyid du dbang bskur bar bya ba de'i phyir chos kyi sprin no⑫/ /⑫mi ha bran pa ⑫la ste gha ⑩nya'o/ /ming la ⑫gha ⑫nyid do/ /sprin chen po 0ltar 'jig rten pa'i 0dge ba'i lo tog mngon par 'phel ba'i don du lhun gyis grub ④par chos thams cad kyi char pa 'bebs so zhes 0pas kyang chos kyi sprin ༅no/ /sprin ༅dang chos mthun pa yang rnam pa gsum ste / khyab par byed pa las ni sa 'dir ༅thob 0pa'i chos kyi ⑤nam mkha' ⑤bzhin du rten 0la khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /rdul rab tu zhi bar byed pa las ni 0chos des sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i rdul rab tu zhi bar byed pa nyid kyi phyir 63—1519

ro / /①'phel bar byed pa ②las ni ②dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa la sogs pa'i rim gyis sems can gong du sgrol bar ④byed pa'i phyir te/ sprin gyi char pas lo tog 'phel bar byed pa bzhin no/ /⑤de ltar ni 'phags pa sa bcu pa la sogs pa'i mdo sder ④bstan pa'i rim pas ⑦de ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu ji snyed pa'i mthar ⑤thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su ⑨mngon par dbang bskur ba ⑫zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ⑩du 'gyur te/ ⑩gang mngon du gyur ma thag la stong gsum gyi mthar thug pa ⑩'bum phrag ⑫bcu tshang ba'i tshad kyi rin po che chen po'i pad+ma rnam pa thams cad mchog dang ldan pa'i rin po che skelas bskrun pa ⑫stong gsum 'bum phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul ji snyed pa dang ldan pa'i rin po che chen po'i pad+ma'i 'khor can 'byung bar 'gyur te/byang chub sems dpa' de'i lus kyang ⑩de dang 'tsham par ⑫gnas so/ /⑫de ting nge 'dzin de thob pa las pad+ma de la 'dug par kun du snang ngo / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' ⑤de la bskor nas blta zhing pad+ma'i 'khor de rnams la gnas so༅/ /④de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rab tu g.yo bar gyur to/ /ngan song thams cad rgyun chad pa dang / spyod pa mthun pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'du ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi lha dang mi'i sil snyan dang glu dang rol mo'i sgra dang 0/ sems can thams cad bde ba skye ba dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la 0mchod pa dang sterim gro bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'jug pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyis kyang rnam par rig par 'gyur ro/ /byang 63—1520

chub sems dpa' ①de'i zhabs kyi mthil dag las 'od zer grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu byung nas phyogs bcu rnams su mnar med pa'i mthar thug pa'i sems can dmyal ba pa rnams snang ba sngon ma can sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byed do//de bzhin du pus mo gnyis nas dud 'gro rnams so/ /②lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nas yi dwags rnams so/ /rtsib ②logs dag nas mi rnams so/ /phyag ④dag nas lha dang lha ma yin rnams so/ /phrag pa dag nas nyan thos kyi theg pa pa rnams te⑤/ chos snang ba'i sgo nye bar sgrub pa'o/ /rgyab dang mgrin pa las ④rang sangs rgyas rnams te ④zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo'i tshul lo⑤/ /zhal gyi sgo nas sems dang po bskyed pa nas bzung ⑨ste ji srid sa dgu pa rjes su thob pa'i bar gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams te⑫/ shes rab dang thabs la mkhas pa'i tshul yang ngo ⑫/ /smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas ⑫bdud kyi gnas thams cad mog mog por ⑫byas nas dbang bskur ba'i sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lus la nub ⑫par 'gro'o/ /steng du yan lag dam pa ⑫las stong gsum grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu tshang ba'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis phyogs bcu rnams su nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams snang bar byed do⑫/ /'jig rten gyi khams ⑫la lan bcur bskor ba byas nas/ steng gi bar snang la 'od zer gyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnams byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa dang rim gror bya ba 'jug par byed do/ /phyogs bcu rnams na ma lus pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi nang du gtogs pa'i me tog ⑫la sogs pa dang / gdugs dang na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan la sogs par gdags 63—1521

pa ji snyed pa de las ①shin tu 'das pa bkod pa sna tshogs pa rin po che la sogs pa'i char rnams de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du sprin chen po rnams bzhin du char 'bab po/ /mchod pa de rnams sems can gang rnams kyis shes pa ②de rnams thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu ②nges par ④'gyur ro / /de'i rjes su de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyi zhabs kyi 'og gi mthil rnams su nub par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams spyode rnams nas kyang sa dgu pa ji srid pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa rnams lhags ④nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de la yang dag par mchod pa ④de blta zhing ting nge 'dzin stong phrag bcu ④la snyoms par 'jug go/ /byang chub sems dpa' ⑨de'i yang thugs ga na gnas pa'i mtshan dpal gyi be'u dang rdo rje dang bkra shis las/ bdud kyi dgra thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer chen po 'od zer grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu'i 'khor can spros nas phyogs bcu rnams snang bar byas shing cho 'phrul mu med pa rnams yang dag par bstan te/ slar log nas ⑫dpal gyi be'u dang rdo rje dang bkra shis kho na la nub par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' de'i mthu ⑫stong 'gyur las lhag par mngon par 'phel lo 7de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu rnams nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i spyo'od zer grangs med pa'i 'khor can rnams kyis ⑫'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams mtha' med pa rnams snang bar byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa rnams yang dag par bstan zhing / byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa rnams bskul 63—1522

te/ phyir log nas byang chub sems dpa' ①de'i yan lag mchog ②la nub par 'gyur ro/ /②de'i 'khor gyi 'od zer rnams ni 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyi bor nub par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' de yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yul la/ ye shes chen po'i dbang gis dbang bskur ba ④zhes ①brjod do/ /④rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba yang 'thob po/ /rang gi smon lam gyi stobs bskyed pas kyang lus sna tshogs pa rnams kyis skad cig gcig la phyogs bcu rnams su 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa rnams na rdul phra rab rnams ji snyed pa de snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams ⑦bkang nas/ dge ba bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi char ⑧gyis bsam pa ji lta bar sems can rnams kyi thog ma med pa'i dus can gyi mi shes pa las byung ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rdul dang me lce ⑨thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /⑩de'i phyir sa 'di chos kyi sprin zhes brjod do/ /de asnyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su yang dga' ldan gyi pho brang du bzhugs pa nas bzung nas ji srid yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i bar de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa thams cad sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba dang ⑫gdul bya ji lta ba rnams la byin gyis rlob po/ /ye shes kyi dbang de lta bu dang ldan zhing shin tu rnam par brtags pa'i ye shes dang mngon par shes pa chen po can ⑩de 'dod na kun nas nyon mongs pa can gyi 0'jig rten gyi khams ⑩ni yongs su dag pa nyid du byin gyis rlob po/ /⑫yongs su dag pa ni ⑩kun nas nyon mongs pa can nyid du'o/ /dog pa ni yangs pa nyid du'o/ /yangs pa ni dog pa nyid du yang ⑫ngo ⑫rdul phra rab gcig tu ༅'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa rnams 0byin gyis rlob 63—1523

ste / rdul phra rab de yang 'phel ba med la bya ba de rnams kyang kun du ston to/ /①'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu ②'jig rten gyi ②khams grangs med pa'i bkod pa ④dang ④/ de na ④gang sems can yod pa rnams kyang kun du ston to/ /⑦'jig rten gyi khams gcig gi ⑧bkod pa dang der sems can gang yod pa rnams kyang 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa rnams su'o⑨/ /'jig rten gyi khams grangs med par gnas pa'i sems can rnams skra'i khyon gcig tu ⑩ste/ ⑫de rnams la gnod pa yang med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi bkod pa grangs med pa yang skra'i khyon gcig tu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa rnams na rdul phra rab ⑫ji snyed pa de snyed kyi ⑫lus rnams skad cig gcig la sprul par byed do/ /lus re re la yang ⑫de snyed kyi lag pa rnams dang de snyed kyi ⑫mgo bo so so la de snyed kyi lce rnams kyang ston par byed do/ /lag pa de rnams kyis kyang phyogs bcu rnams su bde ba can dang pad+ma can dang 'od zer can la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa rnams su sangs rgyas mchod pa la rab tu sbyor ro/ /lag pa 7re res kyang gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang mnyam pa nyid 0me tog gi phur ma rnams sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams la 'thor ro/ /de bzhin du dri la sogs pa nas ji srid na bza' dang gdugs dang rin po che la sogs pa'i bkod pa'i bar du yang ngo / /'byu de rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas de rnams kyi bsngags pa ⑪brjod pa dang gsol ba 'debs pa yang byed de bcom ldan 'das rnams ji ltar 'os par chos bstan du gsol zhes pa la sogs pa dang / gang yang 0sems can 0gyi bya ba ④rdzogs pa lta bu/ thabs kyis gdul bya rnams brtson par bya ba'i ched du mya ngan las 'das ⑥pa ston par bzhed pa mya ngan las 'das par 63—1524

bab pa med pa de rnams la/ 'gro ba ma lus pa la ①dge ba bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi phan pa'i ched dang ⑤mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i 'bras bu grub pa'i mtshan nyid kyi bde ba'i ched du/ ②sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i bskal par bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs su gsol zhes bsnyen bkur byas shing phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba 'debs par byed do//sems kyi ༷skad cig re re la phyogs bcu khyab ⑤par 'gro ste ④mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub par ⑦bkod pa nas ⑧yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i bkod pa ji srid pa rnams byin gyis rlob po/ /dus gsum gyi lus tshad med pa nyid dang ⑨/ rang gi lus la bcom ldan 'das tshad med pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi ⑩zhing gi bkod pa grangs med pa rnams ⑪dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'jig pa dang chags pa thams cad kyang ngo / /⑫rlung gi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang ba spu'i khung bu gcig nas 'byin te sems can rnams la steganod pa yang med do/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi ⑫mthar thug ⑫pa'i chu'i phung po gcig tu byen gyis rlob pa dang / ⑩der yang pad+ma chen po dang pad+ma de'i 'od kyi bkod pas ⑫'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas par ⑩khyab par byed do/ /⑪der yang byang chub kyi shing chen po ston par byed pa nas rnam pa thams cad mchog dang ldan pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du yang ngo / /④rang gi lus la yang phyogs bcu rnams kyi nor bu dang glog dang zla ba'i 'od nas ⑨ji srid 'od dang snang ba'i bkod pa thams cad kyi bar du byin gyis rlob po/ /kha'i dbugs kyis phyogs 0re re 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa g.yo bar byed de/ ④sems can rnams skrag par yang mi byed do/ /phyogs bcu'i rlung gis 'jig pa dang 63—1525
